fact: In August 2025 the regulator ARPTC mandated Professor Kodjo Ndukuma Adjayi of the Universite Protestante au Congo on a 45-day scientific consultancy to harmonise the telecoms and Digital Code laws, with an interim report and stakeholder consultations held 1-6 October 2025.
title: Mission de Consultance Scientifique : Harmonisation des textes legislatifs des secteurs des Telecoms, des TIC et du Numerique en RDC
